body: Promise tracker on KPIT Technologies (IT mid-caps peer set). 6 concalls (Jul-2025 to Oct-2026); 12 promises, 5 scored. Status counts: {'delivered': 4, 'partly': 1, 'pending': 7}. Weighted delivery 95.9% (specificity-only 95.5%; hit rate 80.0%); MCS 0.959. Every FY26 statement resolved delivered or partly (21% EBITDA -> 20.8%; H2 > H1; Q4 highest growth quarter, though only +1.8% CC). The record breaks at FY27: the 20.5-21.2% EBITDA guide given on 7-May-2026 met a 17.2% Q1 within weeks as the two largest SDV programmes ended, 'FY27 growth higher than FY26' is off track, and margin recovery has slid to 'early next year'. These are pending, so the score does not yet show it - a clear case where a good scored record coexists with a likely large miss. Research, not advice.
